description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、主人公「スレッタ・マーキュリー」の一般制服姿がFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury ", the main character " Thretta Mercury" in her regular uniform is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

description.ja: 新規タンポ印刷の表情パーツや多彩な表情デカール、ハンドパーツなどが付属！
description.en: Includes new tampo-printed expression parts, various expression decals, hand parts, and more!

description.ja: ●　一般制服で立体化！
description.en: ● Three-dimensional in general uniform!

description.ja: アスティカシア高等専門学園に於ける一般制服カラーで立体化！
description.en: Three-dimensional in the general uniform color at Astikasia College of Technology!

description.ja: 制服の色分けはパーツ分割で再現。胸元のマークは付属シールで装飾。
description.en: The color coding of the uniform is reproduced by dividing the parts. The mark on the chest is decorated with the included Seal.

description.ja: 髪パーツは、パーツ構成を考慮し立体的な形状で再現。
description.en: The hair parts are reproduced in a three-dimensional shape, taking into account the part composition.

description.ja: ブーツ表面のシワやハンドパーツは繊細な指先まで細かく表現！
description.en: The wrinkles on the surface of the boots and the hand parts are detailed down to the delicate fingertips!

description.ja: ●　豊富な表情パーツが合計5種付属！
description.en: ● A total of 5 types of rich facial expression parts are included!

description.ja: 新規タンポ印刷の表情が付属！
description.en: A new tampo printing expression is included!

description.ja: その他に新規造形を含めた計４種類の表情再現用パーツが付属し、水転写デカールと併せてスレッタのバラエティー豊かな表情を再現。
description.en: In addition, a total of 4 types of expression reproduction parts including new models are included, and together with water transfer decals, Thretta's rich variety of expressions can be reproduced.

description.ja: 別売りの「Figure-rise Standard スレッタ・マーキュリー」（一般店頭販売アイテム）にも各表情パーツは使用可能！
description.en: Each facial expression part can also be used for the separately sold "Figure-rise Standard Thretta Mercury" (general over-the-counter sales item)!

description.ja: ●　豊富な付属品！
description.en: ● Abundant accessories!

description.ja: 耳パーツの開閉を再現できるハロや、スレッタのポージングを支えるディスプレイ用台座も同梱。
description.en: Also included is a halo that allows you to recreate the opening and closing of the ear parts, and a display pedestal that supports Sletta's poses.

description.ja: 劇中で登場したトマトと専用の右手パーツが新規造形で付属！
description.en: The tomato that appeared in the movie and the special right hand part are included with new modeling!

description.ja: 付属品：　ハロ　／　トマト×１個　／　フェイスパーツ×５種（内タンポ印刷１種）　／　ハンドパーツ一式　／　ディスプレイ用台座
description.en: Accessories: Haro / Tomato x 1 / Face parts x 5 types (inner tampo printing 1 type) / Hand parts set / Display pedestal
